Nikon HE / HE* RAW decoder extension, LGPL-2.1 option

Pinned candidate source from pdcgomes/redlamp-libraw:
https://github.com/pdcgomes/redlamp-libraw/tree/f4956c404fba0c6035ce9e06353d4b4ffe068fc7
Archive SHA256: 316b25600f0d8cc00518464f5558060beb756ffa7fa619a02a0bbe877bf8686e
The complete source is built as an isolated candidate module. The host's
ordinary LibRaw 0.22.2 archive remains separate and unchanged.

Copyright (C) 2026 Dmitri Sotnikov, Jiang Yaogeng and other authors named
in the individual source headers. The upstream public implementation is
LibRaw PR 826 (yogthos, head 499bfd4cbf802c2fb5eac4c9a6f53bbeb776cad1).
https://github.com/LibRaw/LibRaw/pull/826

This pin includes RdWing's bottom-edge, lookup-bound, exact integer transfer
and raw-GCLI fixes, and Redlamp contributors' reentrancy, geometry and
malformed-stream checks. Preserve every source's authorship and licence.
LibRaw offers LGPL-2.1 or CDDL-1.0; this build selects LGPL-2.1 (LICENSE.LGPL).

SpektraLab integration, 2026-10-31, shayt0ny:
engine/cmake/RawCandidate.cmake builds the pinned source into an isolated
module. Auto tries stable LibRaw 0.22.2 first, then the candidate on RAW
decode failure. Strict libraw/candidate modes are also available. The
candidate routes MakerNote NEFCompression 13/14 plus the JPEG XS signature
to the HE decoder. Both backends use the app's same linear ProPhoto decode
contract; film/paper models and the spectral pipeline are unchanged.
The candidate is not an official LibRaw release. Unsupported headers fail
explicitly; no embedded JPEG is substituted as editable RAW.

samples.json and goldens.json retain Redlamp's reproducible decoder bench
references. Photographs are not included here or in the release package.
Raw.pixls.us samples are CC0; the separately identified Play Raw sample is
CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution in samples.json.
